summary: Defines DOTS signal channel configuration parameters that peers can negotiate to use the CoAP Q-Block1 and Q-Block2 options. These allow faster, more robust transfer of large amounts of data, which helps during DDoS attacks when packets may be lost.

eli5.summary: When a road is jammed, you send a big load as small boxes that can each be resent if lost, instead of one huge truck that must start over.

questions: how to send large data during a ddos attack
